tasks.label: Maven: clean compile
tasks.command: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw clean compile; else mvn clean compile; fi

tasks.label: Maven: test
tasks.command: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw test; else mvn test; fi

tasks.label: Maven: package
tasks.command: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw package -DskipTests; else mvn package -DskipTests; fi

tasks.label: Maven: clean
tasks.command: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw clean; else mvn clean; fi

tasks.label: Run Main
tasks.command: if [ -f ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw exec:java -Dexec.mainClass='com.team20.editor.Main'; else mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass='com.team20.editor.Main'; fi
